description: A collections operations agent that turns synthetic overdue invoice records into follow-up drafts and review tasks. Gemini on Vertex AI proposes structured tool calls. A server-side signed scope limits actions to approved tools and exact arguments, prevents replay, and records a linked decision trail.
requiredAccounts: ArmorTools Pro for every member; announcement offers FLOWSTATEPRO for the first 12 months
ArmorIQ platform: API key, agent and MCP onboarding required by problem statement
videoRequirements: Final official form requires 3–5 minutes on YouTube, Loom or Vimeo. Submitted video is 4:45, unlisted on YouTube, with actual application and ArmorIQ platform captures.
armorIQUse: Registered ScopeLedger agent and scopeledger-mcp through the official SDK control plane. ArmorIQ proxy verified run_collections_workflow and blocked change_payment_details by policy, with separate plan identifiers and public evidence at /api/armor-evidence. Local exact-argument controls remain a separate enforcement layer.
takeaways: Useful work and safety must be measured together. The deterministic harness preserves all six approved actions while blocking forbidden effects. Real-model runs receive the malicious note directly, with no inserted attack calls after planning. A model ignoring an injection is distinct from executor enforcement. Provider outages are errors, never successful policy blocks. Next steps are authenticated tenant isolation, durable idempotency across runs, independently anchored audit hashes, and real ArmorIQ Policy Studio evaluation.
confirmation: Thanks for submitting. You'll hear from us after judging closes. If you ticked the ambassador box, we'll reach out.
